title: Important and strategic directives from the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, delivered during a meeting with senior commanders of the Armed Forces—as read out by a television presenter.
text:
Important and strategic directives from the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, delivered during a meeting with senior commanders of the Armed Forces—as read out by a television presenter."

"SOT1, TV Presenter (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:39): “The Supreme Leader described intelligent combat readiness as essential for a strong confrontation with enemies and for achieving maximum deterrence, and stressed that every level and type of threat must be met with an immediate and effective response, with no geographic restrictions. Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei stated that if enemies resume military or terrorist attacks, it will be the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic and the Iranian nation that determine the time and conditions for ending them.”"
" "
"SOT2, TV Presenter (Farsi)-(00:40 - 01:11): "The Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces also emphasized strengthening the military information architecture; deepening homegrown defense in both doctrine and tactics; developing modern defensive and security capabilities through the use of new technologies; and reinforcing spiritual foundations and the jihadi spirit, while also making sustained efforts to meet the welfare needs of the Armed Forces and support them.""
" "
"SOT3, TV Presenter (Farsi)-(01:12 - 02:01): "It has also been decided that the target bank will be updated so that all types of tangible and intangible assets of the American-Zionist enemy are placed within the targeting range of the Armed Forces. He considered national support for the Armed Forces to be one of the pillars of deterrence against foreign adversaries of Iran and their domestic mercenaries, adding that the nation’s eight-month presence in the streets and squares is an extension of the eight-year Sacred Defense which, together with the continued steadfastness of the military, law enforcement, and Basij forces, has protected, and will continue to protect, Iran’s territorial integrity and the Islamic system.""
" "
"SOT4, TV Presenter (Farsi)-(02:02 - 02:33): "The Leader of the Islamic Revolution, while expressing appreciation for the wise steadfastness of the Resistance Front in various countries, identified the unity of the fronts as a decisive variable with strategic influence in shaping a new political and security order in West Asia, and expressed hope that this new order would create growing opportunities for the unity of Islamic nations and governments in forming a new Islamic civilization.
